items.title: Andrew Bailey Interview, 1959-09-26
items.q: Yeah, I know Sam Morgan. He came from down below.

ctx.x: Did you ever know which bands played there? Did Sidney Desvina, I know, played there for a while?

Yeah, yeah. Yeah, they played there. Any other bands that you know of? Yeah, Sidney played there. Buddy Petit played there plenty too. Yeah, Buddy Petit played there plenty. What was he like? Did you know Buddy very well? Buddy Petit? Well, I knew him. He was a little older than me, but I had a bum with him, but I knew him. Yeah. About going to the dances and things. What did he look like? Little brown-skinned fella. Short brown-skinned fella. What about Chris Kelly? Well, Chris Kelly, he was another good player,…
But what happened at first in the Bonkays? Well, it'd be a Society. No, I mean when you first come to it,
